definitions.meaning: lan truyền nhanh trên mạng, trở nên nổi tiếng trên internet

examples: Her video went viral overnight and got millions of views.
The company's viral marketing campaign was a huge success.

definitions.meaning: bài đăng (trên mạng xã hội)
đăng bài, chia sẻ nội dung lên mạng xã hội

examples: She wrote a long post about her trip to Japan.
He posts photos of his food on Instagram every day.

definitions.meaning: theo dõi (tài khoản của ai đó trên mạng xã hội)

examples: I started following her account after seeing her cooking videos.
The singer has over five million people following him on social media.

definitions.meaning: thích, bấm thích (nhấn nút like trên mạng xã hội)
lượt thích

examples: More than two thousand people liked his photo within an hour.
She checks how many likes her posts get every morning.

definitions.meaning: bình luận (trên mạng xã hội hoặc bài viết)
bình luận, để lại ý kiến

examples: She left a kind comment on his photo to cheer him up.
People commented both positively and negatively on the new policy.

definitions.meaning: chia sẻ bài viết hoặc nội dung cho người khác xem

examples: He shared the article with his friends on Facebook.
Please share this post if you found it helpful.

definitions.meaning: thẻ bắt đầu bằng dấu # để phân loại nội dung trên mạng xã hội

examples: She added the hashtag #travel to help people find her post.
Using the right hashtags can help your content reach more people.

definitions.meaning: trang cá nhân, hồ sơ người dùng trên mạng xã hội hoặc internet

examples: Make sure your profile photo is clear and professional.
He updated his profile to show his new job.

definitions.meaning: tên người dùng, biệt danh dùng để đăng nhập hoặc nhận diện trên internet

examples: Choose a username that is easy to remember.
Her username on Twitter is the same as on Instagram.

definitions.meaning: mật khẩu dùng để bảo vệ tài khoản

examples: Always use a strong password to keep your account safe.
She forgot her password and had to reset it by email.

definitions.meaning: tải lên, đăng tệp hoặc nội dung lên internet

examples: He uploaded a new video to his YouTube channel yesterday.
It takes a few minutes to upload photos with a slow internet connection.

definitions.meaning: tải xuống, lưu tệp từ internet về thiết bị

examples: She downloaded the app on her phone and started using it right away.
You can download the report as a PDF from the website.

definitions.meaning: phát trực tiếp hoặc xem nội dung trực tuyến liên tục
buổi phát trực tiếp (livestream)

examples: Millions of people stream music every day instead of buying CDs.
She went live to stream her cooking show for her followers.

definitions.meaning: thông báo từ ứng dụng hoặc mạng xã hội

examples: She turned off notifications so she could focus on her work.
He gets a notification every time someone comments on his post.

definitions.meaning: quyền riêng tư, sự bảo mật thông tin cá nhân trên internet

examples: Check your privacy settings to control who can see your posts.
Many people are concerned about their online privacy.

definitions.meaning: tài khoản trên một trang web hoặc ứng dụng

examples: You need to create an account before you can comment on the site.
Her account was hacked, so she changed her password immediately.

definitions.meaning: tìm kiếm thông tin trên internet
cuộc tìm kiếm

examples: Just search for it online and you'll find the answer quickly.
She did a quick search to find the nearest restaurant.

definitions.meaning: lướt web, xem qua nội dung trên internet một cách thong thả

examples: He spends hours browsing social media before going to bed.
She was browsing the internet when she found the perfect recipe.

definitions.meaning: cuộn màn hình lên hoặc xuống để xem nội dung

examples: She kept scrolling through her feed but nothing interesting appeared.
Scroll down to the bottom of the page to find the contact form.

definitions.meaning: đường dẫn, liên kết dẫn đến một trang web hoặc nội dung khác
liên kết, gắn đường dẫn đến nội dung khác

examples: She shared a link to the article in her story.
Click on the link below to read the full news report.

definitions.meaning: nội dung (bài viết, video, hình ảnh được tạo ra và chia sẻ trên mạng)

examples: She creates content about fitness and healthy eating for her followers.
Good content keeps people coming back to your page regularly.

definitions.meaning: người có tầm ảnh hưởng trên mạng xã hội, có nhiều người theo dõi

examples: She became an influencer by sharing honest product reviews online.
Many brands now pay influencers to promote their products.

definitions.meaning: đang thịnh hành, đang được nhiều người quan tâm và thảo luận trên mạng

examples: That song is trending on every music platform right now.
She always knows what topics are trending on social media.

definitions.meaning: ứng dụng nhắn tin, phần mềm dùng để gửi tin nhắn trực tuyến

examples: She sent him a voice message through the messenger app.
Most people use a messenger to keep in touch with friends and family.

definitions.meaning: chú thích, đoạn mô tả đi kèm với ảnh hoặc video trên mạng xã hội

examples: She spent ten minutes thinking of the perfect caption for her photo.
A funny caption can make people stop and look at your post.
